scope: Independent source trace and minimal repair proposal only; root owns implementation/qualification; no product edits or new execution performed by C.

current_route.behavior: F2 handled in autoload _input; return_to_launcher is called.
Cancels ordinary playable recovery metadata, then defers direct change_scene_to_file; no asynchronous-owner gate.
ObjectShard entry routes directly to object_shard_worker_rehearsal.tscn and starts a new host/worker.
Only own reset and window-close keep scene processing until Host.Closed. F2 does not call either. _ready sets SceneTree.auto_accept_quit=false and there is no _exit_tree restoration.

close retires queued/inflight host actions and requests stop; later poll joins only after worker stopped, releases main RIDs, closes trace and marks Closed. Refusal/deadline becomes ShutdownHeld with owner retained.

Dedicated stop flag+wakeup remains available under queue saturation; current native call completes before same-owner reset/disposal. Refused disposal retains native instance/thread; successful release publishes stopped and then safe join is allowed.

minimal_change_set.change: Before ordinary immediate scene replacement, detect an opt-in request_feature_launcher_navigation method on current scene. If present, delegate and return unconditionally; a refused/pending result must never fall through to replacement. Keep all scenes without this method on the existing route.

Implement the opt-in hook and an explicit closing destination (launcher or process quit). Reuse current asynchronous Host.close/poll/Closed transition. Navigation prevents new edits/ticks/burner work, explicitly records cancellation of queued UI intents, cancels a pending replacement preset, and keeps the old scene until owner disposal and RID release are confirmed.

Drive the actual autoload F2 input/return path with a real native worker and Rapier host; keep external references for observation only. Assert old-owner stop/join and RID closure before new scene entry; include in exact-source qualifier and package replay.

state_contract.when: Idle, Opening, loading, running or awaiting native/physics acknowledgement
state_contract.request: Record navigation intent; stop further scheduling; invoke Host.close once; keep old scene active and call poll(true) on later frames.
state_contract.completion: Transition only after Host.state==Closed; a queued receipt/stop flag alone grants no release authority.

state_contract.request: Navigation supersedes replacement: clear pending preset/replacing flag and prevent _begin_owner. Existing stop remains idempotent.
state_contract.completion: Old owner closes then navigate; never construct an intermediate new World.

state_contract.when: diagnostic receipt hold or Held state
state_contract.request: Navigation uses explicit session stop, bypassing diagnostic receipt consumption hold; no extra semantic/Rapier time is minted.
state_contract.completion: Successful same-owner disposal allows close; refusal/deadline retains owner, view and Export.

state_contract.request: Repeated F2 is idempotent. A window-close request may upgrade destination to process quit; F2 never downgrades a pending process quit.
state_contract.completion: One completion action only, fenced by same current scene and Closed owner.

state_contract.request: Skip native work; schedule the selected completion once.
state_contract.completion: No new host opens during navigation. Restore previous SceneTree.auto_accept_quit before successful launcher handoff.

state_contract.when: ShutdownHeld or stop disposal refused/deadline exceeded
state_contract.request: Remain in existing scene, show exact reason and preserve Export; a fresh explicit F2/window-close may retry Host.close.
state_contract.completion: No scene replacement, dropped owner or unconditional join. Existing worker/RIDs remain owned until a subsequent valid Closed result.

state_contract.when: scene transition itself returns an error after Closed
state_contract.request: Retain/readably report the error and permit explicit retry; do not restart a native World automatically.
state_contract.completion: A failure must not cause silent automatic retry every process callback.

non_negotiable_order: request stop → exclusive worker finishes current native call → native session disposal succeeds → worker stopped → main joins stopped thread → main releases Rapier RIDs and closes trace → Host.Closed → restore SceneTree quit policy → change scene or quit
implementation_cautions: Do not implement _exit_tree as a blocking wait for an active native thread; it is too late to retain the scene on disposal failure.
Do not call FeatureNavigation.return_to_launcher recursively from completion while the hook is still installed. Complete using a narrowly fenced final transition or a separate completion method.
Use a neutral navigation cancellation event/count for not-yet-admitted UI intents; do not mislabel them as explicitly_cancelled_by_reset.
Restore the prior auto_accept_quit setting, captured before M3 overrides it, rather than assuming every future parent scene wants true.
Preserve uncertain in-flight edit retirement and incomplete trace semantics already implemented by Host.close; navigation must not convert unknown mutation outcomes into a complete replay.
Do not change ordinary Workbench ownership, broader PUBPRES scheduling, native laws, production default route or GCR.
required_adversarial_checks: F2 with actual moving body and a native request in flight; verify old worker stop+join, bridge space/RIDs gone, trace terminal state, and a new launcher with restored quit policy.
Repeated F2 while closing creates one stop/handoff; window X while closing upgrades to process exit without reopening a scene.
F2 during initial fixture loading and during UI Reset/scenario replacement prevents all subsequent owner reconstruction before handoff.
F2 after a held/lost acknowledgement and F2 during diagnostic receipt hold use explicit disposal; stale late receipt cannot resurrect the old session.
Injected real stop-disposal refusal/deadline preserves old scene/native owner/RIDs and Export; repeated explicit request retries through same contract.
Re-enter M3 after completed navigation and prove only the new native worker remains; normal window close exits and preserved Lab entry still operates.
